findings.notes: Secondary citation; total arsenic.

exposure.statement: BMDL01 values for inorganic arsenic between 0.3 and 8 µg/kg b.w. per day for cancers of lung, skin and bladder and skin lesions; dietary exposures of average and high consumers within this range, little or no margin of exposure.

For cocoa drinks, arsenic per cup = 20 g cocoa powder plus 180 mL milk (dilution estimated from manufacturers' recommendations); coffee/tea/cocoa category adjusted mean as liquid 0.0035 (LB) - 0.0051 (UB) mg/kg; cocoa not separated in exposure.

contradictions_with_stored_summary: Stored summary reports only the adjusted category means (sugar/chocolate 0.0135-0.0320; coffee/tea/cocoa 0.0035-0.0051 mg/kg) and omits the cocoa (n=245, LB mean 40.9, UB 68.3 µg/kg, P95 155, max 830) and chocolate (n=558, LB 12.5, UB 31.3 µg/kg, max 385) sub-category statistics.
unresolved: Values are total arsenic; no inorganic arsenic data for cocoa/chocolate.
Cocoa category mixes powder and beans; chocolate category includes chocolate-based products.
